summary: Programs cannot infer a conforming deadline or mandatory GC cycle from WeakRef/FinalizationRegistry semantics.

source.pattern: observable behavior conditioned on target collection by deadline

semantics.optimization: liveness may depend on implementation reachability analysis
semantics.translation: must preserve nondeterminism rather than force CLR GC

caveats: Tests that call host-specific gc() are host tests, not ECMAScript semantic guarantees.

tests.name: portable test avoids gc
tests.input: let x={}; const r=new WeakRef(x); x=null; console.log(r.deref()===undefined||typeof r.deref()==='object')

tests.name: registry callback optional
tests.input: let n=0; const f=new FinalizationRegistry(()=>n++); let x={}; f.register(x,1); x=null; console.log(n===0)
